instruction: My amazon prime membership just expired yesterday. Renew it for the same duration.
notes: Single-app task (amazon). The agent must discover the duration of the just-expired prime subscription via show_prime_subscriptions (modeled as static facts last-subscription / subscription-duration plus a knowledge predicate known-duration asserted only for that duration), discover a registered payment card via show_payment_cards, then call subscribe_prime with that card and the same duration. Because the correct duration is a runtime value that cannot be a domain constant, the goal is expressed with the nullary (prime-renewed), which subscribe_prime can only assert once the looked-up duration is known; (subscribed-prime ?d) records the state change. Evaluation only checks that exactly one new PrimeSubscription with the same duration was added, so no other state changes are modeled. complete_task takes no answer (not a question).
